snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide – Skitarii Class Reveal Trailer | Warhammer Skulls 2026
snippet.description:
The Skitarii class is coming to Warhammer 40,000: Darktide 23 June.

Wishlist now
► https://fatshark.games/08TKqZ

The Adeptus Mechanicus will not see the secrets of Hive Tertium fall into the hands of heretics, the Skitarii Alpha Primus are elite operatives devoted to serving the will of the Omnissiah. They will annihilate all who stand in their way.

See all the Skulls 2026 reveals on Warhammer Community: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/2eknkrto/skulls-2026-the-warhammer-video-games-festival/
